note: The downloads behind scripts/data/nhl-seasons/*.json, each cached in the ignored data-src/nhl-seasons/<file> and pinned by its SHA-256 (`pin`: 'table' pins only the page's ratings table, the one part that stays the same between requests). node scripts/sync-nhl-seasons.mjs --fetch downloads a missing one; --pin records new hashes after a deliberate new download.
